items.informal_name: Schwartz-Zippel Lemma: Root Bound via Supremum of Exponent Ratios
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card
items.informal_description: For any non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ in $ n $ variables over a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any finite subsets $ S_i \subseteq R $ for each variable, the ratio of the number of roots of $ p $ in the product set $ S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n $ to the product of the cardinalities $ \prod_{i=1}^n |S_i| $ is at most the supremum over all monomials $ s $ in the support of $ p $ of the sum $ \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{s_i}{|S_i|} $, where $ s_i $ denotes the exponent of the $ i $-th variable in the monomial $ s $. All divisions are performed in the non-negative rational numbers $ \mathbb{Q}_{\geq 0} $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Upper Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the coefficient of a monomial $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero, then the weighted order of $ f $ is less than or equal to the weight of $ d $, i.e., $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) \leq \sum_{i \in \operatorname{support} d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Lower Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if every monomial $ d $ with weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) < n $ has zero coefficient in $ f $, then the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to $ w $ satisfies $ n \leq \text{weightedOrder}_w(f) $.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound on Weighted Order of Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For any extended natural number $n$, if every monomial $d$ with $\text{weight}(w, d) < n$ has zero coefficient in the multivariate power series $f$, then $n \leq \text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$, where $\text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$ denotes the weighted order of $f$ with respect to the weight function $w$.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Equals n iff Existence of Minimal Non-Zero Coefficient
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ↑n ↔
    (∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ (Finsupp.weight w) d = n) ∧
      ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of $ f $ is equal to $ n $ if and only if there exists a monomial $ d $ with non-zero coefficient in $ f $ such that the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) = n $, and every monomial with weighted sum less than $ n $ has zero coefficient in $ f $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Non-Zero Coefficient at Weighted Order in Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  ↑(MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f).toNat = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f →
    ∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the weighted order of $ f $ is a natural number, then there exists a monomial $ d $ such that the coefficient of $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero and the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ equals the weighted order of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Weighted order of a multivariate power series
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of $ f $ is the minimal natural number $ n $ such that there exists a monomial $ d $ with non-zero coefficient in $ f $ where the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ equals $ n $. If $ f $ is the zero series, the weighted order is $ \top $ (infinity).

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = if a = 0 then ⊤ else ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_eq_nat
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ↑n ↔
    (∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ (Finsupp.weight w) d = n) ∧
      ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0

items.name: MvPowerSeries.nat_le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_monomial_of_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.informal_name: Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →
    {T : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.

items.informal_name: Lower bound on degree of support under exponentiation in additive monoid algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), n • f.support.inf degt ≤ (f ^ n).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring and $ A $ an additive monoid. For any function $ \deg : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfying $ \deg(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \deg(a + b) \geq \deg(a) + \deg(b) $ for all $ a, b \in A $, and for any $ f \in R[A] $ and $ n \in \mathbb{N} $, the inequality $ n \cdot \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f)} \deg(a) \leq \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f^n)} \deg(a) $ holds, where $ \text{supp}(f) $ denotes the support of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Infimum Degree Inequality in Additive Monoid Algebra Product
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T]
  {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A), ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For a commutative semiring $ R $ and an additive commutative monoid $ A $, let $ \text{degt} : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfy $ \text{degt}(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \text{degt}(a + b) \geq \text{degt}(a) + \text{degt}(b) $. For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : s \to R[A] $, the sum of the infima of $ \text{degt} $ over the supports of each $ f(i) $ is less than or equal to the infimum of $ \text{degt} $ over the support of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f(i) $.

items.informal_name: Inequality for Infimum of Degrees in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (l : List (AddMonoidAlgebra R A)), (List.map (fun f => f.support.inf degt) l).sum ≤ l.prod.support.inf degt
items.informal_description: Given a degree function $\text{degt}$ on an additive monoid algebra $R[A]$ satisfying $\text{degt}(0) \geq 0$ and $\text{degt}(a) + \text{degt}(b) \leq \text{degt}(a + b)$ for all $a, b \in A$, and a list $l$ of elements in $R[A]$, the sum of the infima of $\text{degt}$ over the supports of each element in $l$ is less than or equal to the infimum of $\text{degt}$ over the support of the product of all elements in $l$.

items.informal_name: Meet of Infima of Supports is Less Than or Equal to Infimum of Support of Sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  (degt : A → T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), f.support.inf degt ⊓ g.support.inf degt ≤ (f + g).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For elements $ f $ and $ g $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[M] $, the infimum of their supports with respect to the degree function satisfies $ \inf(\text{supp}(f)) \sqcap \inf(\text{supp}(g)) \leq \inf(\text{supp}(f + g)) $.

items.informal_name: Subadditivity of Support Infimum under Multiplication in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : Add A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
    ∀ (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), f.support.inf degt + g.support.inf degt ≤ (f * g).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For any subadditive degree function $\deg : A \to T$ on an additive monoid $A$, and for all elements $f, g$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$, the sum of the infima of the supports of $f$ and $g$ under $\deg$ is less than or equal to the infimum of the support of their product $f \cdot g$ under $\deg$. Formally, $\inf_{\text{supp}(f)} \deg + \inf_{\text{supp}(g)} \deg \leq \inf_{\text{supp}(f \cdot g)} \deg$.
